criticalDiscrepancies.latinText: Patet itaque abesse profecto plurimum ut nos Deiparae supernaturalis gratiae efficiendae vim tribuamus, quae Dei unius est.
criticalDiscrepancies.frenchText: Il s'en faut donc grandement ... que Nous attribuions à la Mère de Dieu une vertu productrice de la grâce, vertu qui est de Dieu seul.
criticalDiscrepancies.italianOnlineText: È dunque evidente che noi dobbiamo attribuire alla Madre di Dio una virtù produttrice di grazie: quella virtù che è solo di Dio.
criticalDiscrepancies.safeReading: Mary is not attributed the proper divine power of producing supernatural grace; Christ alone is its source. Mary's intercession is derived/dependent.
criticalDiscrepancies.action: Prefer Latin for doctrinal meaning; mark affected Italian webpage sentence as suspect and check a physical critical edition before asserting an editorial erratum.

criticalDiscrepancies.verdict: Q342 asks the age at which Easter Communion obligation begins, not directly the complete eligibility/preparation test for a child's First Communion.
criticalDiscrepancies.safeReading: Use Quam Singulari DH 3531–3532 for minimum pre-Communion doctrinal knowledge and continued catechesis; Q342 only secondary background.

criticalDiscrepancies.verdict: The indexed Q335 includes the then-prescribed fast from midnight; that prescription must not be recast as current Catholic fasting law.
criticalDiscrepancies.safeReading: For the Eucharistic Real Presence, cite Q325 and/or Q331; for knowing whom one receives, Q338; never present Q335's old fasting detail without date and current-law caveat.

criticalDiscrepancies.verdict: Selected 15 Italian catechism questions now located in a pinned Italian transcription; 10 independently cross-checked with a second Italian website. The 1912 printed edition/facsimile remains uninspected; authorial diction still not directly attributable to Pius X.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: Latin confirms grace-production is divine alone and Marian intercession does not compete with Christ; distinction adoration vs veneration also needs explicit catechetical source if presented as an exact quotation.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Keep simulated prose clearly unquoted; disallow discrepant Italian positive grace-production reading.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: Christ is the source, Mary intercedes through Christ's merits; original Latin specifically attributes to Bernard the aqueduct metaphor.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Anchor to Latin and note incompatible web-Italian phrase; do not suggest Mary independently produces grace.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: The Hail Mary seeks Mary's intercession in life and death; directing Marian devotion toward Christ is supported by the encyclical's purpose.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Practical advice is composed, not papal reported speech.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: DH 3531: complete Christian doctrinal knowledge is not required before First Communion; DH 3532: child understands necessary mysteries in proportion to capacity and distinguishes Eucharistic bread from common bread.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Make Quam Singulari DH 3531–3532 primary; Q342 only supplementary; ensure context concerns readiness, not general relaxed standards.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: Catechism Q325 directly states consecrated Host is true Body of Christ; Q338 addresses faith and reverence; Quam Singulari explains a child's discernment.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Cite Q325 for real presence. Q335 unnecessary here and carries historic midnight-fasting rule; keep it out of the main evidence IDs.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: Quam Singulari DH 3531 explicitly mandates continuing instruction and gradual acquisition of full Catechism afterwards; catechist instructed to teach accessibly.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Keep short; preserve 'after First Communion' temporal distinction.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: Q232 identifies the authority of divine revelation; Q114 and Q236 explain Church as entrusted teaching authority.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Original 1912 Italian exact phrase not collated: doctrinally plausible paraphrase only, not a verified Sarto direct expression.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: Q114–116 distinguish Church's teaching office and conditions of infallibility; application to casual remarks by individual priests is a reasonable inference, not verbatim Q114–116.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Do not equate all individual episcopal or papal utterances with nonauthoritative opinions; broader magisterial nuances require content-owner judgment.

turnReviews.originalSynthesis: Request for a precise proposition supports catechetical method rather than claiming authentic recorded Sarto words.
turnReviews.requiredAction: Keep quote attribution false; no scripted answer to unspecified personal doctrinal controversy.
